title: A Survey on Stereotype Detection in Natural Language Processing
reasoning: The paper is a comprehensive survey on stereotype detection, which includes religion as one of the primary demographic groups analyzed. It reviews multiple datasets and studies (e.g., StereoSet, BBQ, HaSpeeDe2) that evaluate religious bias and stereotypes. Additionally, it discusses theoretical frameworks such as 'deontological ethics' and the 'ABC model,' which incorporates the sharing of ethical and political values into the analysis of social perception.
